title: Alpha015 post coverage-guard rerun: valid parent candidate, LOOP01 not improved
summary: Step4 formal signal coverage is now valid for Alpha015 parent, LOOP01, and LOOP02. Parent has strong gross long-side and RankIC evidence but fails official promotion on drawdown, recovery, turnover cost, and cost-adjusted Sharpe. LOOP01 improves RankIC but worsens the economic objective; LOOP02 slightly reduces turnover but worsens the broader objective.

mechanism.economic_hypothesis: Persistent negative high-volume/high-price rank-correlation, confirmed by amount and moderated by turnover, captures active liquidity pressure created by constrained or attention-driven participants.
mechanism.math_object: ranked rolling high-volume correlation pressure path

lessons: Formal non-null signal coverage is a prerequisite for promotion-gate evidence.
Higher RankIC is not sufficient when long-side return, recovery, and cost-adjusted Sharpe worsen.
Slightly lower turnover is not sufficient when capital path and cost-adjusted quality remain worse than the parent.
Alpha015 carries real ordinal information and should not be discarded as no-signal.
The next revision should target capital path geometry and horizon stability, not pure IC maximization.
